title: 3.14 More Jobs
unit_outcome: Introduce yourself and others in Spanish: name, age, where you are from, your job and what you have.
goal: Name more jobs: mesero, policía, artista, cantante, trabajador, mecánico.
speaking_outcome: Say and ask what someone's job is.
